important_limits: Probe granted both legacy and modern API forms; production metadata still uses its existing legacy grants.
Requested timeout duration was not precise; the runtime contract is terminal timeout signaling, not millisecond accuracy.
Logical cancellation alone did not stop transport and late progress/load still arrived at the probe.
Physical abort produced manager onabort plus controlled-server request-aborted/response-close; this does not prove every network-stack byte ceased.
Route observation and downloads were not part of this gate.
